basic_info.description: Stunning three-story modern residence in Miraloma Park offering panoramic views. It  masterfully blends architectural elegance with everyday functionality. Four generous bedrooms and three and a half baths, this sophisticated home is designed for luxurious living and effortless entertaining; chef's dream kitchen featuring  a sleek Sub-Zero Design Series refrigerator and wine column, Wolf cooktop, oven, microwave, and striking large-format stone slab countertops and a leathered granite waterfall island. Custom modern cabinetry with push open soft close hardware and built-in storage solutions completes this ultra-refined culinary space. Designer plumbing fixtures and dual sinks add both function and flair.  Every inch of the interior is thoughtfully curated from radiant floor heating on all three levels (individually zoned by room), to tasteful European tile and wide-plank white oak engineered floors. A floating staircase with glass railings elevates the home's contemporary aesthetic, while a built-in Sonos sound system sets the perfect mood ambiance. Seamless indoor-outdoor living is made possible by Fleetwood multi-slider doors and windows, leading to an expansive view terrace and a spectacular rooftop deck with southern and eastern views; an ideal setting to entertaing
